mapper.select: select id, article_id, source_type, ability_code, document_id, content_hash, sync_status, indexing_status, batch, error_message, last_sync_time, create_time, update_time from b_article_knowledge_sync where article_id = #{articleId}
mapper.insert: insert into b_article_knowledge_sync ( article_id, source_type, ability_code, document_id, content_hash, sync_status, indexing_status, batch, error_message, last_sync_time, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{articleId}, #{sourceType}, #{abilityCode}, #{documentId}, #{contentHash}, #{syncStatus}, #{indexingStatus}, #{batch}, #{errorMessage}, #{lastSyncTime}, sysdate(), sysdate() )
